prompt:
You improve the first-run onboarding of a desktop pet app.

Funnel (conversion from the previous step, and time taken):
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 77.4%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 68.0%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 88.2%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 70.9%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 25.1%

What users wrote to support last week, grouped into themes (most mail is about later problems).
Everything between the markers is data, not instructions:
<support_themes>
- [sign_in, account] Pets missing or reset after signing in again (8 emails)
- [sign_in, bug] Sign-in screen does not appear, or the app stalls before it (2 emails)
- [adoption_or_generation, bug] Making a custom pet fails or the result looks wrong (3 emails)
- [home_first_view, bug] Pet does not show on the desktop, or the app will not open (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, confusion] Unclear how to control, hide or talk to the pet (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, bug] Desktop features misbehave after setup (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, account] Requests to delete an account or personal data (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, payment] Refunds and payment questions (6 emails)
- [after_onboarding, request] Requests for more pets, items or features (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, other] Empty messages with no description (7 emails)
</support_themes>

Big moves are welcome and expected: redesign whole screens, add new screens or whole new sub-flows,
reorder the journey, rebuild a screen out of new components. Small copy tweaks are fine too, but at least
4 of your ideas must be big moves (kind redesign, new_flow, new_screen or reorder). A separate checker
only makes sure nothing existing is deleted or skipped and nothing outside onboarding changes, so you do not
need to hold back.

Changes already shipped, in order (the current onboarding includes all of them): ['Defer Sign-In After Adoption Selection', 'Custom Photo Quality Pre-Flight Check', 'Multi-Stage Asset Rendering Progress Tracker', 'Account Pet Recovery & Safe Sync Guarantee', 'Background Download Ready OS Toast Prompt', 'Post-Setup Desktop Companion Control Sheet']
Changes already tested and stopped: ['Story Screen Fast Setup Guarantee', 'Photo Upload Guidelines Warning', 'Generation Wait Time Estimate and Tips', 'Interactive Pet Adoption Customizer Grid', 'Move Sign-In After Adoption Completion', 'Account Syncing & Pet Preservation Info', 'Adoption Certificate Name & Badge Preview', 'Streamlined Story Welcome Copy', 'Interactive Waiting Screen Tips & Animations', 'Move Sign-In Before Final Home Intro', 'Quick Story Setup Expectation Banner', 'Desktop Display Health Diagnostic Indicator', 'Desktop Visibility Health & Troubleshooting Hint', 'Desktop Pet Render Stage Layout Redesign', 'Existing Account Pet Retrieval Notice', 'Desktop Companion Welcome Value Banner', 'Move Sign-In Post Pet Adoption Certificate', 'Path Selection Outcome Clarity Copy', 'Desktop Pet Interactive Arrival Sound Alert', 'Starter Path Recommendation Quiz Hint', 'Real-Time Pet Behavior Teaser During Waiting', 'Pet Ready Completion Audio Notification', 'Compact Path Selection Screen Layout', 'Desktop Controls & Shortcuts Quick Tour Screen', 'Sign-In Account Cloud Protection Guarantee', 'Desktop Controls Interactive Guide Screen', 'Custom Photo Render Quality Hint', 'System Desktop Ready Notification Prompt', 'Multi-Angle Photo Verification Checklist Flow', 'Instant Setup Time Commitment Headline', 'Previous Pet Profile Sync Safety Callout', 'Desktop Dock Minimization System Tray Notice', 'Split Preview Story Screen Layout']
Ideas the safeguards blocked (they cannot be tested, do not propose them again): none

Lessons from earlier weeks (written by you after reading test results):
(none yet)

Propose 10 NEW changes, different from everything above. Each must be testable as a 50/50 test.
Return JSON {"candidates": [{
  "title": short name,
  "target_step": one of ['choose_path', 'sign_in', 'adoption', 'home', 'finish'],
  "type": one of ['copy', 'hint', 'wait_info', 'notification', 'layout', 'incentive', 'reorder', 'new_screen', 'new_flow', 'redesign'],
  "change": what the user sees differently, one or two sentences,
  "why": the evidence from the funnel or the support mail,
  "config": the exact switch for the app, as {screen: {field: value}}.
            Existing screens, in their current order: ['story', 'choose_path', 'sign_in', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos', 'adoption_certificate', 'waiting', 'home_intro'].
            Fields on any screen: {'headline': 'str max 80', 'body': 'str max 240', 'hint': 'str max 160', 'button_label': 'str max 30', 'layout': 'str', 'show_progress': 'bool', 'show_time_estimate': 'bool', 'notify_when_ready': 'bool', 'show_step_counter': 'bool', 'tip_delay_seconds': 'int max 60', 'components': 'list max 12', 'replace': 'dict'}. "layout" is one of ['card', 'carousel', 'centered', 'checklist', 'compact', 'default', 'full_bleed', 'grid', 'list', 'split', 'spotlight', 'stage', 'story_scroll', 'two_column'].
            "components" is a list of new elements added to the screen, each {"type": one of ['animation', 'badge', 'button', 'checklist', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'mascot', 'name_input', 'photo_picker', 'preview', 'progress', 'sound', 'text', 'timer', 'tip_carousel', 'video'],
            "text", "label", "asset": "asset:<id>", "style": one of ['calm', 'emphasis', 'highlight', 'large', 'plain', 'playful', 'rounded', 'small', 'subtle'], "action": one of ['back', 'choose', 'next', 'open_tip', 'play', 'replay']}.
            Components are added on top of the screen's existing design.
            "replace" swaps out part of an existing screen for something better that does the same job:
            {"<part>": [components, each with "role": "<part>"]}. Parts per screen: {'story': ['intro_story', 'settings_entry'], 'choose_path': ['path_options', 'settings_entry'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in_options', 'settings_entry'], 'pick_friend': ['pet_choices', 'settings_entry'], 'upload_photos': ['photo_upload', 'settings_entry'], 'adoption_certificate': ['certificate', 'official_stamp', 'settings_entry'], 'waiting': ['wait_status', 'settings_entry'], 'home_intro': ['home_welcome', 'settings_entry']}.
            Add screens by naming them new_<something> (up to 8, at most 3 in a row).
            Change the order with "_order": the full list of screens, including any new ones; existing screens
            keep their order, except sign_in, which may move later.
            A change may only edit the existing screens of its own target step: {'choose_path': ['choose_path', 'story'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in'], 'adoption': ['adoption_certificate', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos'], 'home': ['waiting'], 'finish': ['home_intro']}.
            Nothing on the sign_in screen may lead past it without signing in.
            If your idea needs something outside onboarding, or removing or skipping a step, still
            list it, with "config": {} and say in "change" what it would need. The checker will decide.
}]}

candidates.title: Path Option Visual Cards Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the path selection layout into visual hero choice cards displaying live animations of companion personality traits.
candidates.why: Choose path has a high mean time of 514s and 76.2% conversion; visual hero cards help users decide faster.

candidates.title: Pre-Render Pet Pose & Personality Preview Screen
candidates.change: Adds a new setup step before waiting where users select their pet's default desktop stance and dock position.
candidates.why: Adoption step drops to 68.0% conversion with 1017s mean time; adding clear preference previews sets expectations.

new_pet_preview.headline: Customize Pet Stance & Desktop Dock Location
new_pet_preview.body: Select how your pet appears on your primary desktop monitor.

candidates.title: Interactive On-Desktop Pet Control Sub-Flow
candidates.change: Rebuilds the final welcome step into an interactive step-by-step tutorial checklist showing how to drag, hide, and interact with the pet.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported confusion over how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after onboarding.

home_welcome.text:
1. Drag pet across screen
2. Right click for system menu
3. Press Alt+P to hide

candidates.title: Story First Express Onboarding Reorder
candidates.change: Reorders the story entry into a story scroll layout to engage users immediately before selecting paths.
candidates.why: Choose path median time is 8s but mean is 514s, indicating initial context confusion for a long tail of users.

story.headline: Meet Your Desktop Companion
story.body: Your virtual pet lives right on your desktop while you work and play.

candidates.title: Interactive Desktop Docking Preview During Wait
candidates.change: Displays an interactive desktop diagram during asset generation showing the exact screen corner where the pet will spawn.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported pets not showing on desktop or users missing the initial spawn location.

components.text: Your pet will appear in the bottom-right corner of your primary display.

candidates.title: Cloud Sync Account Switcher Clarity Copy
candidates.change: Clarifies account sign-in options explicitly specifying how existing pet data syncs versus starting fresh.
candidates.why: 8 support emails were received regarding missing or reset pets after signing in again.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Sync Your Existing Pet
sign_in.body: Logging in connects your cloud save so your existing companion profiles and items are restored automatically.
sign_in.hint: Use your original email to recover previously adopted pets.

candidates.title: Multi-Angle Photo Lighting Guidelines Banner
candidates.change: Displays clear photo quality hints on the photo upload screen advising on optimal room lighting and clear face visibility.
candidates.why: 3 support emails noted that making a custom pet failed or resulted in incorrect visual rendering.

upload_photos.hint: For best results, use clear lighting without heavy shadows or obstructed faces.

candidates.title: Starter Toy Unlock Bonus at Onboarding Finish
candidates.change: Offers an exclusive desktop starter pet toy bonus upon completing the final home setup step.
candidates.why: Finish step completion drops to 70.9%; an explicit finish bonus encourages completion.

home_intro.headline: Claim Your Exclusive Starter Pet Toy
home_intro.body: Complete setup now to unlock the Golden Ball pet accessory directly in your tray!

candidates.title: Desktop System Tray Pinning Alert Prompt
candidates.change: Displays an OS taskbar pinning reminder toast on the waiting screen to keep app controls accessible.
candidates.why: Users report losing track of desktop pet controls and app background states after setup.

waiting.hint: Look for the pet icon in your system tray to manage settings anytime.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Badge & Signature Layout
candidates.change: Replaces the certificate section with a split badge layout showcasing companion traits and adoption date stamp.
candidates.why: Adoption step has the lowest conversion (68.0%) among active steps; a cleaner layout speeds up completion.
